name: Scripture Scroller
author: Chuck Keith
description: One hundred encouraging Berean Standard Bible passages in a peaceful, offline bar ticker.

barWidget.description: An offline ticker of encouraging Berean Standard Bible passages.

schema.label: Passage interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often a new passage appears.

schema.label: Ticker width (pixels)
schema.description: Width of the scrolling passage on a horizontal bar.

schema.label: Scroll speed (pixels/second)
schema.description: Minimum ticker speed. Long passages accelerate enough to finish before rotation.

schema.label: Pause on hover
schema.description: Pause the ticker and rotation while the pointer is over the widget.
